capabilities: . Adjust line height for CJK lines
. Adjust line height for CJK paragraphs
. Add .cjk CSS class to CJK lines and paragraphs
intentEvidence: This is useful because CJK characters typically require more line height than European alphabets.
problem: Standard line height settings often do not adequately accommodate the increased vertical space required by CJK characters compared to European alphabets.
summary: Dynamically adjusts the line height of lines and paragraphs containing CJK characters in Obsidian to accommodate their specific vertical spacing requirements.
